speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with agitation and a yellowish discoloration of your skin and eyes, along with abnormal lab results. To determine the cause of these symptoms, have you experienced any recent nausea, vomiting, or loss of appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: 20-year-old male. The patient was previously healthy and has been brought to the emergency department due to agitation over the past 24 hours. Family members have noticed a yellowish coloring of his skin and eyes over the past week. The patient has a history of occasional cocaine and ecstasy use, and drinks alcohol socially on weekends. The patient also admits to high-risk sexual behaviors without using appropriate protection.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Hepatitis A infection with acute liver failure.

Based on your recent high-risk sexual behaviors and the rapid onset of jaundice and agitation, I suspect a viral hepatitis or drug-induced liver injury. Have you had any recent travel to endemic areas or contact with someone diagnosed with hepatitis?
